data.title: Prievartavimo sukelta trauma: vienatvė, alkoholis, savižudybė ir „pati kalta“
data.description: Seksualinio smurto nusikaltimai pastaruoju metu aptariami aktyviai, o ilgai normomis laikyti šio nusikaltimo vertinimai, jį gaubiantys stereotipai ir teismų sprendimai kvestionuojami. Epsteino failai, Pelicot byla, Cornell 7 grupinės prievartos universitete istorija, Lietuvoje – kunigų vykdomas vaikų išnaudojimas, „Siaubo parko“ byla – keli iš labiausiai aptariamų pavyzdžių. Pastarojoje Klaidui Sinicai, vaikų pramogų parke išžaginusiam moksleivę, skirtas laisvės atėmimas trejiems metams, bausmę atidedant dvejiems metams. Jei per tą laiką teisėsauga nefiksuos naujų vyro nusikaltimų, jis į laisvės atėmimo įstaigą nepateks.

data.title: Latvians made more than 5 million trips last year
data.description: In 2025, there were 1.20 billion personal and professional trips made by residents in the EU, a 1.4% increase from 2024 (+17 million trips). Of the total, 848 million were domestic trips (70% of the total) and 264 million were foreign trips within the EU (22%), which means 92% of the trips made by EU residents were intra-EU. This information comes from data on trips by EU residents published by Eurostat today.

data.title: Autumn season of Documentary Mondays starts at Czech Centre in Bucharest
data.description: The autumn season of the film program Documentary Mondays will cover four film screenings, followed by meetings and discussions with special guests. The four films explore “lives transformed by the passage of time and relationships that endure or fall apart, following people confronting their own pasts and undergoing changes that force them to redefine their relationship with the world around them.” The series opens on October 12 with Petr Záruba’s Kaprálová , a documentary about Czech composer Vítězslava Kaprálová. In 1937, at just 22, she left for Paris to continue her musical studies; three years later, her life came to a premature end. The film retraces her life through archival footage and letters she sent to her family in Czechoslovakia, while also exploring how her music is being rediscovered today by a new generation of performers. The documentary also features Czech conductor Alena Hron, who recorded Kaprálová’s complete orchestral works with the Janáček Philharmonic Ostrava. Hron will attend the screening at the Czech Centre and take part in a Q&A with the audience afterwards. Alena Hron Photo courtesy of the Czech Center A week later, on October 19, the series showcases Michelle Memran’s The Rest I Make Up , a portrait of Cuban-American playwright María Irene Fornés, one of the leading figures in American experimental theatre. After dementia gradually forces her to give up writing, an unexpected friendship with filmmaker Michelle Memran rekindles her creative spontaneity and becomes the starting point for a collaboration filmed over several years. The screening will be followed by an online discussion with director Michelle Memran. María Irene Fornés with her Obie award Photo courtesy of the Czech Center On October 26, the program presents, in partnership with KineDok Romania, Miro Remo’s Better Go Mad in the Wild . Loosely inspired by Aleš Palán and Jan Šíbík’s book about people who have chosen to live in seclusion, the film follows two brothers who share the same farm and a life almost completely cut off from civilization, yet have very different ideas about the future. The documentary won the Crystal Globe at the 2025 Karlovy Vary International Film Festival. While helping a woman find her biological mother, the filmmaker is drawn into her own family history and sets out to trace the sisters from whom she was separated. The film had its world premiere in the international competition at CPH 2026, and its preview screening at the Czech Centre will be followed by a discussion with members of the film crew. Still from 'Something Familiar' The program runs at the Czech Centre in Bucharest from October 12 to November 2. Admission is free, with entry on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to available seating. The films are screened with English subtitles.

data.title: Decommissioned plane gets stuck under bridge near Bucharest
data.description: A decommissioned passenger plane became stuck beneath a bridge on Romania’s DN1 road overnight in the Balotești area, north of Bucharest, Digi24 reported. The aircraft, which had its wings removed for transport, was travelling from Bucharest Henri Coandă International Airport to Voluntari. One traffic lane was blocked while crews worked to clear the road. The plane was subsequently moved to a nearby car park. Images of the aircraft stuck under the bridge were shared on social media. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XKYACd5qkQ According to media reports, the authorities plan to resume the journey overnight after making changes to the vehicle and equipment used to transport the aircraft.

data.title: Bison found dead and decapitated in Romania, police investigate suspected poaching
data.description: A bison was found decapitated in the area of Ilva Mare, Bistrița-Năsăud County, by locals on Thursday, October 8. A day later, an animal protection association, Ramses, filed a complaint with the police, and a criminal file was opened. The bison is a protected species in Romania. "A body without a head and questions to which the authorities must find answers. The Ramses Association has filed a complaint requesting that the perpetrator be identified and demanding the maximum prison sentence provided by law, to be served, for the illegal killing of this animal," officials of the Ramses Association said in a post on Facebook. https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=122172621038713104&set=pb.61571393144351.-2207520000&type=3&locale=ro_RO The discovery was officially confirmed by the Bistrița-Năsăud County Police, and teams from the Bistrița-Năsăud County Police Inspectorate and the Directorate for Veterinary Health and Food Safety (DSVSA) were sent to the scene. "A team consisting of police officers from the Weapons, Explosives and Hazardous Substances Bureau, together with officers from the Sângeorz-Băi Rural Police Section 7, identified the animal's carcass in the area of Ivăneasa," the police announced on Friday. The discovery was confirmed by the county prefect, Stelian Dolha. The absence of the head raises suspicions of possible poaching, but the cause of death and the circumstances in which the animal was decapitated are to be established through the investigation. The bison weighed around 800 kilograms and had been spotted in the region since August, peacefully grazing around people's properties. A few days earlier, forester Iosif Buia Pop had photographed it. "I suspect it came from an area where bison have been reintroduced, possibly in Neamț County, but I don't know for sure where it came from or how long it will stay here. I'm glad I had the opportunity to see such a specimen in the wild, in the middle of the forest. It has an imposing presence and dimensions that the photograph does not truly capture," Iosif Buia Pop said at the time, cited by TVRInfo . According to Bistrițeanul.ro , DSVSA representatives had intervened the day before because the animal appeared weak and had foam around its mouth. The bison had been sedated, and samples had been collected for testing. The animal's carcass will undergo an autopsy to establish the exact cause of death.

data.title: Romania’s Mangalia shipyard sold to Rheinmetall for EUR 138 mln
data.description: Damen Shipyards Mangalia has been sold to Rheinmetall Real Estate Romania for EUR 138.03 million, excluding VAT, judicial liquidator CITR announced on Friday, October 9. The company won the auction conducted as part of the shipyard’s insolvency proceedings. CITR said the transaction could allow operations to resume at the shipyard, which it described as one of Romania’s most important industrial assets. “The sale concludes a complex asset-valuation process intended to ensure operational continuity and provide an encouraging outlook for the future,” said CITR CEO Paul Dieter Cîrlănaru. The sale price was at 75% of the EUR 184 million market value used for the previous four auctions, according to Ziarul Financiar . Those attempts ended without a buyer. Damen Shipyards Mangalia entered insolvency on June 19, 2024, following a request from its parent company, Damen Holding BV.

data.title: Stockholm’s Teater Tribunalen brings Holocaust-themed play to Bucharest as part of Romanian tour
data.description: The Bucharest performance, a free-entry one, is scheduled for October 10 at the Jewish State Theater. The production, performed in Swedish with Romanian subtitles, stars Adriana Savin, Henrik Dahl and Gaianeh Pilossian. The Teater Tribunalen tour opened with two performances at the International Theatre Festival for Young Audiences in Iași and will continue at the Marin Sorescu National Theatre in Craiova (October 12), Bacovia Municipal Theatre in Bacău (October 14), Piatra Neamț Youth Theatre (October 15), and Maria Filotti Theatre in Brăila (October 17). The production, developed on a concept by Adriana Savin, grew out of the artist’s attempt to reconstruct the story of her father, a Jewish man from Bucharest who survived persecution during World War II. The project also draws on Mihail Sebastian’s Journal 1935–1944 and brings the memory of the Holocaust in Romania into dialogue with transformations in contemporary European society. “The Father, the Pogrom and the Parallel examines the mechanisms through which prejudice, discrimination and the search for scapegoats can gradually become part of public discourse and social life. The production explores how what initially seems unthinkable can become acceptable and invites audiences to reflect on individual and collective responsibility in the face of radicalization,” a presentation of the show reads. The play has been written by Adriana Savin and Henrik Dahl. Henrik Dahl is the director. Teater Tribunalen was founded in 1995 by actors who had graduated from the Malmö Theatre Academy and performing artists from the Institute for Dramatic Arts. Since its establishment, the company has been based at the former Lido cinema on Hornsgatan in Stockholm, with support from the Swedish Authors’ Fund and in ongoing collaboration with ABF Stockholm.

data.title: New bridge, crossing point linking Romania and Ukraine inaugurated
data.description: A new bridge and a border crossing point linking Romania and Ukraine were inaugurated on Thursday, October 8. The project also includes a border crossing point with Ukraine, Sighetu Marmației II, and covers a total of 1.2 km on Romanian territory. In the first phase, only vehicles weighing less than 3.5 tons will be allowed to cross the “Maramureș-Transcarpathia” bridge. Authorities aim to extend traffic to heavier vehicles and buses as the border crossing point becomes operational, according to Mediafax . https://www.facebook.com/reel/1421784903436685 The bridge and border crossing cost RON 135.8 million, and the project took more than four years to complete, having started in July 2022. It was financed through the 2021–2027 Transport Program and carried out in partnership with the Maramureș County Council. The connection to the existing infrastructure in the area is made from DN18 via a roundabout. The bridge was built by the consortium formed by Tehnodomus from Arad and Costin și Vlad Birou de Arhitectură SRL from Cluj-Napoca; the contract for the actual construction of the structure ultimately amounted to around RON 161 million (the equivalent of approximately EUR 32 million, an amount included in the total of more than EUR 50 million for the entire border complex). Romanian border police imposed traffic restrictions from the very opening of the crossing. Traffic remained normal through the other border crossing point, Sighetu Marmației I. Road and pedestrian traffic between Romania and Ukraine currently takes place through the Sighetu Marmației–Solotvino Border Crossing Point, over a bridge built from wood and metal in the early 2000s, with a single traffic lane and two pedestrian walkways. Ukrainian railway authorities also operated passenger services to Sighetu Marmației using access to the broad-gauge railway line built in the early 1950s, with access to Romania provided through the localities of Valea Vișeului and Câmpulung la Tisa. Currently, passenger rail traffic on this route has been temporarily suspended.

data.title: Romanian-founded AI startup Siena raises USD 17 million in Series A funding
data.description: Siena, a startup founded by Romanians Andrei Negrău (co-founder and CEO) and Lisa Popovici (co-founder and CMO) in 2022, has raised USD 17 million in a Series A funding round led by York IE, with participation from Joyance Ventures and existing investors Aglaé Ventures and Sierra Ventures. With the latest inflow, the company reached total funding of USD 29.7 million, according to Profit.ro . Siena will use the new capital to develop more autonomous agents and expand the infrastructure through which brands interact with customers and grow their revenue. The startup started with an AI-based customer service agent and is now expanding its platform to create a common information layer for agents that interact with customers, internal agents, and human teams. In 2023, the company announced that it had secured USD 4.7 million in funding from a group of investors, including Sierra Ventures, Parri Passu Ventures, SpaceStation Investments, Village Global, The Council, and OpenSky Ventures. Siena works with dozens of e-commerce brands in sectors such as beauty, health, nutrition, beverages, and fashion. For example, Eskiin’s Social Agent lifted weekly comment engagement by 50% and freed up 15 hours a week for its social lead. Coterie turned a customer-analysis project that used to take weeks into a ten-minute query with Ask Siena. At SPANX, Siena Intelligence traced a spike in shipping complaints to a single carrier issue affecting nearly every delivery in one region, helping the team pinpoint the fix quickly, according to BusinessWire . “Brands use Siena to help customers buy and guide decisions across the business. When an agent learns why someone buys or leaves, that understanding should travel with the customer and reach the people running the brand. The same understanding that helps an agent resolve a conversation can help a founder decide what to build next. Our ambition is for agents to manage the entire customer journey with that context," said Andrei Negrau, cofounder and CEO of Siena.

data.title: Greenvolt secures EUR 284 mln financing for Romanian wind farm
data.description: Renewable energy developer Greenvolt Power announced that it secured EUR 284 million in project financing for its Gurbănești wind farm in Romania. The project will comprise 42 turbines and is expected to become one of the country’s largest wind farms. The financing was provided by a syndicate of eight institutions: UniCredit, Erste Group Bank, Banca Comercială Română, Siemens Bank, Société Générale, BRD, ING Bank, and Alpha Bank. Each turbine will have a rated capacity of 6.1 MW, according to the company. Construction is already underway at the site, located east of Bucharest. “Romania is an important market for Greenvolt, where we see strong long-term potential, and our investment in the country reflects that,” said Greenvolt Group CEO João Manso Neto. The Gurbănești wind farm forms part of Greenvolt’s 506 MW Wind Rose platform, which also includes a separate 253.1 MW wind project in Ialomița county. Greenvolt reported a utility-scale development pipeline in Romania comprising 707 MW of wind projects, 58 MW of solar capacity, and 209 MW of battery energy storage. The group also operates locally through Greenvolt Next, which provides on-site renewable energy systems for corporate and industrial clients. Greenvolt is part of investment company KKR’s portfolio and operates across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and Asia. Its global utility-scale pipeline totals 12.7 GW across wind, solar and storage projects.

data.title: Romania’s economy stagnates in Q2 2026, contracts 0.6% in first half of the year
data.description: Romania’s GDP remained unchanged in the second quarter of 2026 compared with the previous quarter, while the economy contracted by 0.6% in the first half of the year compared with the same period in 2025, according to provisional data published on Friday, October 9, by the National Institute of Statistics (INS). Seasonally adjusted GDP for the second quarter of 2026 stood at RON 529.676 billion at current prices. It remained unchanged from the previous quarter but fell by 1.9% compared with the same quarter of 2025. In the unadjusted series, GDP for the second quarter stood at RON 501.069 billion at current prices, down 0.2% in real terms compared with the second quarter of 2025. Based on seasonally adjusted data, GDP for the first half of 2026 stood at RON 1,035.681 billion at current prices, down 1.6% in real terms compared with the same period in 2025. In the unadjusted series, GDP for the first half of 2026 stood at RON 907.159 billion at current prices, down 0.6% in real terms compared with the first half of 2025. Compared with the previous provisional estimate, GDP growth was revised upward by 0.2%, while gross value added increased by 0.3%. The volume of gross value added changed more significantly in some economic sectors, according to the report . Agriculture, forestry, and fishing maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.1%), while activity increased by 0.6%, from 105.5% to 106.1%. Industry’s contribution improved from -0.7% to -0.6%, while activity increased by 0.3%, from 95.8% to 96.1%. Construction’s contribution increased from +0.9% to +1.2%, while activity rose by 0.1%, from 115.3% to 115.4%. Wholesale and retail trade, motor vehicle and motorcycle repairs, transportation and storage, and hotels and restaurants improved their contribution from -1.0% to -0.9%. Activity increased by 0.2%, from 95.5% to 95.7%. Information and communications maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-0.2%), while activity increased by 0.3%, from 97.2% to 97.5%. Financial intermediation and insurance maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.1%), while activity remained unchanged at 101.5%. Real estate activities’ contribution fell from -0.5% to -0.7%, while activity decreased by 1.5%, from 93.2% to 91.7%. Professional, scientific, and technical activities, as well as administrative and support services, maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.1%). Activity increased by 0.4%, from 101.3% to 101.7%. Public administration and defence, public social security, education, human health, and social work maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-0.3%), while activity remained unchanged at 98.0%. Arts, entertainment, and recreation, household goods repairs, and other services maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.6%). Activity increased by 1%, from 111.8% to 112.8%. The volume of net taxes on products fell by 0.9% in the latest provisional estimate, from 105.3% to 104.4%. According to INS, household final consumption expenditure maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-1.9%), while its volume remained unchanged at 96.9%. Individual final consumption expenditure by general government also maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-0.1%), while its volume decreased by 0.9%, from 99.2% to 98.3%. The contribution of gross fixed capital formation increased from +4.1% to +4.3% between the two estimates, while its volume rose by 3.4%, from 116.5% to 119.9%, INS said.

Real estate activities’ contribution fell from -0.5% to -0.7%, while activity decreased by 1.5%, from 93.2% to 91.7%. Professional, scientific, and technical activities, as well as administrative and support services, maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.1%). Activity increased by 0.4%, from 101.3% to 101.7%. Public administration and defence, public social security, education, human health, and social work maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-0.3%), while activity remained unchanged at 98.0%. Arts, entertainment, and recreation, household goods repairs, and other services maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (+0.6%). Activity increased by 1%, from 111.8% to 112.8%. The volume of net taxes on products fell by 0.9% in the latest provisional estimate, from 105.3% to 104.4%. According to INS, household final consumption expenditure maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-1.9%), while its volume remained unchanged at 96.9%. Individual final consumption expenditure by general government also maintained the same contribution to GDP growth (-0.1%), while its volume decreased by 0.9%, from 99.2% to 98.3%. The contribution of gross fixed capital formation increased from +4.1% to +4.3% between the two estimates, while its volume rose by 3.4%, from 116.5% to 119.9%, INS said.

data.title: Russia Exploits School Knife Attacks for Disinformation
data.description: Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced on Friday, Oct. 9, that Russia sought to exploit two violent school knife attacks in Poland to mount a coordinated disinformation campaign and stoke public panic. data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. data.title: APANHA-SE MAIS DEPRESSA UM MENTIROSO QUE UM COXO!
data.description:
DSP através da sua equipa de "Lambe-Botas" está cavando cada vez mais a sua própria cova, adiantando cada vez mais o seu fim. Somente alguns acreditavam que foi ele quem estava por trás do "Progresso Nacional" o blog onde começou toda essa história de Mentiras, Calunias, Difamações, Ameaças e tantos outros agressões tóxicas ao espírito humano, a todos os que não estão do seu lado e cujo o único objectivo, era ser chamado de rei dos réis da Guiné. Comandou o Progresso Nacional assim como Bin Laden comandou a Al-Qaeda e acabou por fracassar. Pensou, repensou e resolveu voltar novamente ainda com mais TERROR e está a comandar o Guiné Puro tentando levar toda a nação ao abismo assim como o ISIS quer levar a humanidade. Camaradas, Guiné Puro assim como o falecido Progresso Nacional é o reflexo do espirito de DSP, alí é possivel ver tudo e quanto o sujeito é baixo. DSP é um hipócrita e um anarquista moderno. "ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E COMPRAS?!" essa foi uma das frases da recente publicação que mostram por quem e para que fim, é dirigido o Guiné Puro ou melhor o blog do terror como podem ver já a seguir. Demonstraram mais uma vez claramente que o "MCCI" pertence a DPS, pois uma publicação dessa no próprio blog do ganancioso só pode ser das duas uma: "Boca capli elis ou Foronta passanta e dicidi ca sucundi rostu". Camaradas, Domingos Simões Pereira afundou seu próprio barco devido a sua ganância e complexo de superioridade. "I pirigu pa i faladu ba cuma, el i unicu alguim cu bai escola na Guiné" seu ultimo desejo é "afundar com todos, inclusive o PAIGC". __________PARA A VOSSA CONFIRMAÇÃO, AQUI ESTÁ A PUBLICAÇÃO_________ MARCOS GALINA BARBOSA VAI PERCEBER QUE METEU COM GENTE

data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. Documento António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

data.title: Van Samson wil onderzoek naar overtollig personeel en politieke benoemingen bij staatsbedrijven
data.description: VHP-parlementariër Cedric van Samson vraagt president Jennifer Simons om alle staatsbedrijven grondig te laten doorlichten. Hij plaatst vraagtekens bij overtollig personeel en mogelijke politieke benoemingen bij onder meer EBS, de Melkcentrale en Cevihas. Volgens Van Samson telt EBS ongeveer 1300 werknemers, terwijl het bedrijf naar zijn inschatting met 600 personeelsleden zou kunnen functioneren. Ook verlangt hij concrete resultaten van de regering op het gebied van onderwijs, woningbouw en andere maatschappelijke problemen. The post Van Samson wil onderzoek naar overtollig personeel en politieke benoemingen bij staatsbedrijven appeared first on Suriname Herald .

data.title: Baasaron wil Economische Controle Dienst versterken met meer personeel en bevoegdheden
data.description: Minister Andrew Baasaron wil de Economische Controle Dienst (ECD) versterken met extra personeel, voertuigen en bevoegdheden. De dienst moet meer prijscontroles uitvoeren, ook in de districten. Volgens de minister zijn de prijzen van 20 tot 25 basisgoederen sinds 6 februari gemiddeld met minder dan 1 procent gestegen. Winkeliers die herhaaldelijk regels overtreden, riskeren boetes, inbeslagname van goederen en zelfs sluiting van hun zaak.
